items.title: Wall Street's private blockchain obsession is a 'race to the bottom,' Ethereum advocate Raman warns
items.snippet: Centrally controlled, permission-only networks have a role to play in finance, but need a transparent, open base to reap the benefits blockchain technology offers.
items.note: Позитивний тон для ETH за ключовими словами.

items.title: Kalshi ordered to stop broad range of prediction markets in Washington
items.snippet: Kalshi must implement initial geofencing by Aug. 19 and a GeoComply multi-source geofencing system by Sept. 2.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо загального ринку -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: Galaxy lowers CLARITY Act odds to 10%
items.snippet: Galaxy cited unresolved ethics, stablecoin yield and developer protection issues, along with a narrow Senate window when lawmakers return in September.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.
